user.title: Set up Burd
user.description: Burd tracking needs no account — the hub is created right away. Add parcels afterwards via the integration options or the `burd.track_parcel` service.

data_description.add: Paste the Min levering link from Burd's text message or e-mail, or enter the 18-digit shipment number.

data_description.delivered_filter_type: Show delivered parcels from the last X days, or limit to the X most recent.
data_description.delivered_filter_amount: Number of days or parcels to show.

data_description.include_history: Add a per-parcel history attribute listing each status update (timestamp, status, original text). Off by default.

parcels.title: Manage parcels
parcels.description: One shipment per line. Paste the Min levering link from Burd's text message or e-mail, or enter the 18-digit shipment number. With the link, the integration also shows the evening Burd plans to deliver; with the number alone, only the status.

data_description.tracking_codes: A Min levering link, a tracking link from Burd's website, NUMBER/TOKEN or a shipment number.

error.invalid_tracking_code: That does not look like a Burd shipment number or link.
error.unsupported_link: Only the Min levering link and the tracking link from Burd's website are supported.
error.not_recognised: Burd does not recognise that Min levering link. It may have expired; enter the shipment number instead.
error.token_mismatch: That Min levering link belongs to another shipment number.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Burd. Try again later.
error.already_tracked: That parcel is already being tracked.

track_parcel.name: Track parcel
track_parcel.description: Start tracking a Burd shipment by its Min levering link or shipment number.

tracking_code.name: Link or shipment number
tracking_code.description: The Min levering link from Burd's message, or the 18-digit shipment number. Home Assistant stores the data of every service call, including the link; add the parcel in the integration options if you do not want that.

untrack_parcel.name: Untrack parcel
untrack_parcel.description: Stop tracking a Burd shipment by its Min levering link or shipment number.

tracking_code.name: Link or shipment number
tracking_code.description: The Min levering link or shipment number to stop tracking.

trigger_type.parcel_delivery_time_changed: A parcel's expected delivery time changed
